objectives: Build up the trainee's confidence to safely operate in demanding environments.
Learn to deal with high workload situations by practicing efficient workload management.
Optimal use of automation, proper use and monitoring of all levels of flight automation.
Apply CRM attributes while practicing selected normal & abnormal procedures.
notes: Headset & shoulder harnesses will be used as for real flight.
The instructor will interface with the crew as ATC, mechanic, CIC, etc. IP should intervene to avoid cumulative effects if a situation is not handled correctly.
The crew should not be left to face an excessive workload.
Remaining simulator time should be used to repeat unsatisfactory maneuvers or practice for the proficiency check.
The crew briefing and take-off data calculation will be conducted in the briefing room for time saving.
Sequence of events may be adjusted at instructor's discretion.
Upon IP's request, the autopilot(s) must be disengaged to gain proficiency in manual flight during final approaches with ILS.
